editorial: Today, the focus is on technical analysis of vulnerabilities targeting autonomous agents and the reasoning processes of these models. In the academic literature, efficiency-oriented deep research agents and new loss functions that provide quality improvement in visual production models stand out.

items.title: msitarzewski/agency-agents
items.summary: Agency-agents is an automation library that gathers artificial intelligence agents with different areas of expertise under one roof. These expert agents manage processes such as software development, content production and data validation, enabling users to carry out complex workflows like a digital team.

items.title: semantica-agi/semantica
items.summary: Semantica is a graph-native infrastructure developed to manage contextual data in artificial intelligence systems. By structuring data relationships, it enables generative AI models to produce more reliable and auditable results.

items.title: nvm-sh/nvm
items.summary: Node Version Manager is a command line tool that allows developers to manage multiple versions of Node.js on their systems. With its POSIX-compliant shell script (bash script) structure, it makes it easier to make quick version transitions between different projects.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.summary: Developed for artificial intelligence coding agents, agent-skills is a library that offers production-level engineering skills. This JavaScript-based resource provides standardized tools that enable agents to perform tasks more efficiently in software development processes.

items.title: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
items.summary: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis is an automatic stock market tracking system that analyzes multiple market data and current news using large language models (LLM). This Python-based tool automatically delivers analysis at regular intervals, providing a dashboard that supports investment decisions.

items.title: vitali87/code-graph-rag
items.summary: Code-graph-rag combines knowledge graphs and fetch-assisted generation (RAG) technology to understand complex structures in large code repositories. It allows developers to query multilingual code bases and perform editing with the help of artificial intelligence.

items.title: anthropics/skills
items.summary: Shared by Anthropics, skills offers reusable skill packages for artificial intelligence agents. This open source library helps developers standardize different agentic workflows.

items.title: 3b1b/manim
items.summary: Manim is a Python-based animation engine used to visualize mathematical concepts. It offers a programmatic solution for content creators who want to turn complex theories into explainer videos.

items.title: HKUDS/DeepTutor
items.summary: DeepTutor is an artificial intelligence-based tutoring system that provides personalized education support by constantly monitoring students' learning processes. The model analyzes student performance and creates customized content based on long-term learning needs.

items.title: stablyai/orca
items.summary: Developed by Stablyai, Orca is an agent development environment (ADE) that allows you to manage multiple artificial intelligence agents simultaneously. This tool, which works on desktop, mobile and virtual private server (VPS), allows you to run different coding agents with your own subscriptions.

items.title: paperclipai/paperclip
items.summary: Paperclip is an open source application developed to manage artificial intelligence agents in the workplace. Written in TypeScript, this platform allows digital agents performing different tasks to be controlled from a central point.

items.title: huggingface/transformers
items.summary: Developed by Hugging Face, Transformers is a library used to train and run state-of-the-art machine learning models on different types of data such as text, images, and audio. It provides developers with access to popular artificial intelligence models and the opportunity to fine-tune them.

items.title: harveyai/harvey-labs
items.summary: Harvey Labs is a benchmarking tool designed to measure and improve the capabilities of artificial intelligence agents that support tasks in the legal field. It was developed in Python language to evaluate the performance of models used in legal workflows.

items.title: jaywcjlove/awesome-mac
items.summary: Awesome-mac is a comprehensive resource repository that categorizes and lists high-quality software developed for the macOS operating system. This archive, which allows users to easily find applications that suit their needs, functions as a systematic organization tool.

items.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
items.summary: OpenMontage is an open source system that turns AI-powered coding assistants into a comprehensive video production studio. It automates video content creation processes with twelve different production pipelines, over a hundred tools and over seven hundred agent capabilities.

items.title: practical-tutorials/project-based-learning
items.summary: Project-based learning is a list that brings together resources that teach software development processes through applied projects. It offers a comprehensive guide for those who want to develop real-world applications with different programming languages.

items.title: PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent
items.summary: Prime-Agent, developed by PrimeIntellect, is a self-developing reinforcement learning agent designed for software development processes and long-term autonomous tasks. Written in TypeScript, this tool aims to optimize artificial intelligence-supported software development processes by automating complex workflows.

items.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
items.summary: Researchers show that it is possible to train smaller models using reasoning trace data produced by proprietary large language models (LLM). This method aims to transfer the reasoning capabilities of closed-source models to open-source alternatives.

items.title: England set to be one of the first countries to eliminate hepatitis C
items.summary: England is preparing to be one of the first countries to completely eliminate the Hepatitis C virus, thanks to its comprehensive screening and treatment programs. The healthcare system NHS (National Health Service) is running a large-scale testing process across the country to stop the spread of the virus.

items.title: Compression is prediction
items.summary: The mathematical relationship between data compression and prediction shows that the algorithm that compresses a data best is actually the model that best predicts the structure of that data. This approach offers a basic framework for understanding the working logic of large language models.

items.title: OpenAI’s head of ethics leaves less than a year after joining
items.summary: The executive who headed the ethics unit at OpenAI left the company less than a year after his appointment. This separation brought about discussions about the future of ethical auditing and security processes within artificial intelligence developer OpenAI.

items.title: Mojo 1.0
items.summary: Developed by Modular, Mojo 1.0 is a programming language that combines the ease of use of Python with the high performance of system programming languages. Optimized to run on artificial intelligence hardware, this language offers developers a working environment that is fully compatible with the Python ecosystem.

items.title: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3
items.summary: MiniMax-H3, developed by MiniMax, is an artificial intelligence model that produces videos using visual and text inputs. This technology facilitates video content creation processes by converting the data provided by users into moving images.

items.title: meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B
items.summary: Muse-Glimmer-30B, published by Meta-models, is a multimodal model that produces text-based outputs by processing visual and text data. The model is used in complex content creation processes by analyzing images and combining them with text.

items.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, developed by DeepSeek, is an artificial intelligence model focused on text generation. This language model shared on HuggingFace offers an alternative solution in high-performance content production processes.

items.title: larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora
items.summary: MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora, shared on HuggingFace, is a low-rank adaptation file developed for models with text-to-video capability. This file allows existing video production models to be trained (fine-tuning) more efficiently on specific datasets.

items.title: Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3
items.summary: MiniMax-H3 is a multi-modal large language model with text and visual processing capabilities. This model, offered by Comfy-Org, is used especially in the processes of analyzing and interpreting complex visual content.

items.title: AdvFD: Boosting Visual Generation via Adversarial Fr'echet Distance Loss
items.summary: AdvFD aims to solve the problem of quality loss in Fréchet distance optimization used in visual production models. The method provides improvement in visual production processes by using a dynamic structure instead of static feature spaces.

items.title: Not Worth Another Token: Marginal Value Estimation for Efficient Deep Research Agents
items.summary: Artificial intelligence agents that conduct deep research face high costs and slow operation problems due to unnecessary data accumulation in long-term tasks. By examining marginal value estimation methods for context management, this study offers systematic pruning strategies that determine what data should be retained during the research process.

items.title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation
items.summary: This method, developed for open source large language models, increases the quality of multilingual machine translation without the need for reference text. Using Group Relative Policy Optimization, it combines supervised fine-tuning processes with models that predict translation quality.

items.title: ComBodied Agents: a New Paradigm of Human-Centric Agentic AI
items.summary: The ComBodied Agents approach combines artificial intelligence agents from the digital and physical worlds in a human-centered framework. This model focuses on agents not only changing software or physical states, but also providing personalized support by understanding the user's current psychological and physical state.

items.title: iFAN: Inference-Aware Learning for Plain Mask Transformers
items.summary: iFAN is a new learning method that eliminates the incompatibilities between the inference process and the training phase in image segmentation models. This approach aims to improve mask accuracy by ensuring that the model takes the final prediction phase into account during training.

items.title: GNOME Shell Design Dreams
items.summary: GNOME developers have shared new design goals to improve the user experience for the desktop environment GNOME Shell. This vision aims to create a more consistent visual language and interaction model in the interface.

items.title: Text Watermarking for Non-Academics
items.summary: Text watermarking adds hidden statistical signals to text strings to detect content created by generative AI. Although this method provides evidence to verify the source of the content, it has technical limitations against manipulation.

items.title: Reviewing code is a skill
items.summary: Code review is a process that requires communication and critical thinking skills beyond technical knowledge in the software development process. This skill aims not only to find errors, but also to ensure sustainable team collaboration and code quality.

glossary.explanation: Systems specifically designed to keep data in an interconnected network structure.
Artificial intelligence technology that can produce new text, visuals or sounds based on previously learned information.
A script that automates multi-step operations that need to be done on the computer by writing them into a single file.
Ability to solve complex problems in logical steps and establish technical systems.
An artificial intelligence model that learns to speak and write like a human by reading huge amounts of text on the internet.
A layout in which all codes and files of a software project are collected in a single main folder.
A data map that records information together with their relationships with each other and shows connections between concepts.
A method that allows artificial intelligence to use up-to-date and reliable external documents instead of its own memory when producing answers.
Practical knowledge and application ability required to do a job.
The process of correcting mistakes and guiding a person learning a subject by providing one-on-one guidance.
Digital environments used to accelerate and manage software development processes.
Renting and using a server on the Internet as if it were your own private computer.
The process of retraining a general-purpose trained artificial intelligence with a small data set to become more expert on a specific subject.
A method of measuring the performance of a system or software with standard tests and comparing it with others.
The automated series of stages that software goes through after it is developed and tested until it is released to real users.
Artificial intelligence software that learns to make the right decision by receiving rewards through trial and error.
